title: Sauce action program
description: A sequence of protocol actions that compiles to one Sauce program executing on one chain. Amounts are base-10 strings. Beyond this schema, a program must satisfy: every address with mixed-case hex carries a valid EIP-55 checksum; every amount fits its declared width; an action's chain field (if present) equals chainId; an action with no amount and no amountRef follows an action that produces an output; an amountRef names a saveOutputAs set by an earlier action, and is not combined with an explicit amount; integralSwap is never chained from; argument names are unique; and the value of every balanceOf/nativeBalance/argument action is read.

$schema.description: The schema this document declares; ignored.

chainId.description: The chain every action executes on.

address.description: An address: 0x + 40 hex digits. A mixed-case address must carry a valid EIP-55 checksum.

recipient.description: An address, or "self" for the executing account.

bytes.description: 0x-prefixed hex bytes, an even number of digits.

identifier.description: A name that becomes a local variable in the emitted SauceScript.
